verdict.rationale: Docs confirm device identities are a prerequisite for device-based Conditional Access policies and Intune-based Mobile Device Management, and that MFA/Conditional Access gates app access — the architecture for device-trust gating exists. However, the pack never documents the specific posture signals (disk encryption, screen-lock enforcement) being evaluated in CA policy, relying on inference from generic MDM/Intune compliance integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of encryption/screen-lock compliance checks feeding into Conditional Access, and independent hands-on confirmation that unhealthy devices are blocked in practice.
